arxiv-2211-14707.description: Abstract The study of weak domains and quasicontinuous domains leads to the consideration of two types generalizations of domains. arxiv-2501-12950.description: Abstract Fixed-node diffusion quantum Monte Carlo (FN-DMC) is a widely-trusted many-body method for solving the Schrödinger equation, known for its reliable predictions of material and molecular properties. Furthermore, its excellent scalability with system complexity and near-perfect utilization of computational power makes FN-DMC ideally positioned to leverage new advances in computing to address increasingly complex scientific problems.
